title: stelis kefersteiniana
intro: Stelis kefersteiniana, commonly known as the "Brazilian orchid," is a plant species that belongs to the orchid family, Epiphyllaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral effects. The therapeutic actions of Stelis kefersteiniana include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antioxidant properties. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
